pages.intro:
The Weekly Check-in Coach helps your team stay in step, one short check-in at a time.

- **Asks for a check-in.** Each person gets a short weekly nudge and answers a few quick questions.
- **Turns blockers into WorkQ items.** Anything holding someone up becomes a WorkQ item for the manager.
- **Posts a Friday summary.** Your reviewer approves it before it goes to the team.

Setup takes about three minutes. Nothing is sent to your team until you activate the agent.
